svg.title: A* looks at fewer places than Dijkstra
svg.desc: Two grids of streets with a wall; the places each search looked at are shaded and the route is drawn.
svg.text: Dijkstra: looks in every direction (88 places)
A*: leans toward the goal (41 places)
Both find a route of 14 steps around the end of the black wall.
A* ranks places by steps so far plus a guess of the blocks still to go (straight across to T).
